how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-dire-maul-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7488:obj:0: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the ⟦E1⟧ in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7488:details:0: The mage Lethtendris, a vicious blood elf whose brutality is matched only by her twisted addiction to magic, has fled into Dire ⟦E3⟧. She has created a device, a web to ensnare the magical energies of that place and we ⟦E4⟧ that, if left unchecked, she will cause irreparable ⟦E5⟧ to our world!
rows.quest:7488:details:1: Stop her, ⟦1⟧. Find her and retrieve her web. She is likely near the satyrs in Warpwood Quarter of Dire ⟦E3⟧. Bring the web to me so that its power may be released safely back into the wilds...
rows.quest:7488:progress:0: Do you have the web, ⟦2⟧?  Its concentrated magical energy must be dissipated!
rows.quest:7488:completion:0: You retrieved the web! Well done, ⟦3⟧! Lethtendris, like many elves of her ilk, are blind to the dangers the abuse of magic can cause to our world. They believe they are masters of magic; they do not realize that they are slaves to their own addiction. Her death saddens me, but it was necessary.
rows.quest:7488:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦4⟧. I will have the energies within the web released safely over a wide area, and then I'll destroy it to prevent future magical exploits.
rows.quest:7489:obj:0: Bring ⟦E6⟧ to Talo Thornhoof at ⟦E7⟧ in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7489:details:0: The blood elf Lethtendris has overstepped her bounds. So eager was she to gather magical power that she defied her brethren and created a device of insidious design, a web meant to siphon the tainted magical energies of Dire ⟦E3⟧. Even now she gathers those energies and plans to release them against her ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:7489:details:1: Lethtendris must be stopped. Find her within the Warpwood Quarter of Dire ⟦E3⟧, defeat her and bring her web to me so that it might be returned to more clear-headed blood elves for study.
rows.quest:7489:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦6⟧. This web holds within it vast stores of the magic of Dire ⟦E3⟧, and I ⟦E4⟧ what ⟦E5⟧ may be unleashed if those energies were harnessed by one so irresponsible as Lethtendris. I am saddened by her death, but I know that she could never part with her web while alive.
rows.quest:7489:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦7⟧. I will send the web to students of magic more responsible than Lethtendris. They will be the new wardens of its power.

rows.quest:7441:obj:0: ⟦E12⟧ to Dire ⟦E3⟧ and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's ⟦E13⟧ through any means necessary.

rows.quest:5518:obj:0: Bring 4 Bolts of ⟦E17⟧, 8 ⟦E18⟧, 2 Rune Threads, and ⟦E19⟧ to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5518:details:0: If you're going to fight the king of this dump - and I think that's what you're bound to do - then you're going to need to get by Captain Kromcrush. Now, you can get by him by killing him, sure. You might actually want to leave him alive.
rows.quest:5518:details:1: How, you ask? Since I've been here, I think I know how to make an ogre suit that will last just long enough to fool these bozos. The only problem is stability - ten minutes tops. Bring me what I need, and I'll make you one. I'm not going anywhere...
rows.quest:5518:progress:0: The ⟦E19⟧ is probably the toughest thing to find for what I need to make the suit - I think they have some upstairs?  It's hard to tell, since this ball and chain doesn't make movement that easy to do...⟦13⟧⟦14⟧Anyway, bring me the things I need, and I'll whip you up an ogre suit that will fool Captain Kromcrush into thinking you're one of his men.
rows.quest:5518:completion:0: Yeah, this will do the trick. Just a slip here, and tuck here... heh - this is going to work out just fine! <A broad smile beams from the chained goblin's face.>
rows.quest:5518:completion:1: Here you go, you're all set. Remember- this isn't the most securely fashioned item in the world. You'll have ten minutes of use before it falls apart, and then you're not going to fool anybody! Try using it just before you approach him, and remember... it only will make him think that YOU are an ally - not your group mates!
rows.quest:5525:progress:0: It's called the ⟦E21⟧ - well, that's what these "tons o' fun" keep calling it. I think any of the ogres might have it, but I'm not sure if any specific ones do. rows.quest:5525:completion:0: Oh, thank you for freeing me! You - ranked number one. Everyone else - ranked number two or lower.
rows.quest:5525:completion:1: I knew my life was destined for more than just being an appetizer to some ogre!
rows.quest:5528:completion:0: You da big boss now, so you get free sample of my better brews! These drinks boost you up AND give you good buzz! These are da good ones, chief... you try and tell Kreeg yourself!

rows.quest:8948:obj:0: Take the incomplete ⟦E28⟧ to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8948:details:0: Theldren is not one to willingly participate in a fair fight. I've shaped this banner to display his family colors.
rows.quest:8948:details:1: With some additional sorcery, this banner shall provoke him in a way he won't be able to resist.
rows.quest:8948:details:2: An old acquaintance of mine named Falrin knows the exact procedure required. He has a particular way of... aggravating people. You shall find him at the library in Dire ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8948:progress:0: Speak up stranger, can't you see I'm busy?
rows.quest:8948:completion:0: Anthion sent you, you say? I thought he was dead. I guess I've heard stranger things in my life.
rows.quest:8948:completion:1: Very well, then. What is it you want me to do with this banner?
rows.quest:8949:obj:0: Collect 25 ⟦E29⟧ from Ogres inside Dire ⟦E3⟧ or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:8949:details:0: Yes, it is true that I am familiar with this enchantment you require, ⟦32⟧. Yet I'm not one to give out favors freely, even if you were sent here by an old friend.
rows.quest:8949:details:1: I hold nothing but hatred and contempt for our brutish ogre neighbors. And not only them, I hate the followers of ⟦E30⟧ just as much as I hate those that follow King Gordok.
rows.quest:8949:details:2: I want you to kill them. Kill lots of them! Bring me the beads they carry around their neck as proof of your work. Do this and we shall talk about your request.
rows.quest:8949:progress:0: Have you performed the favor I asked of you, ⟦33⟧?
rows.quest:8949:completion:0: Hmmm... strangely enough I don't feel any better about my brother's death at the hands of those brutes.
rows.quest:8949:completion:1: Well, you held your end of the bargain. Let's see what I can do for you.
rows.quest:8950:obj:0: Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire ⟦E3⟧: 1 ⟦E31⟧, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.
rows.quest:8950:details:0: I can place the enchantment you require on the banner quite easily, ⟦34⟧. Unfortunately I don't have the materials I need as it is very rarely that someone asks for this sort of charm.
rows.quest:8950:details:1: I will require the essence of one of the Eldreth ghosts that haunt these halls, a handful of ⟦E32⟧ dark runes and some large brilliant shards. Bring me these reagents and I shall perform this task for you.
rows.quest:8950:progress:0: Have you gathered the materials I require, ⟦35⟧?
rows.quest:8950:completion:0: Yes, these will do just fine. After I'm done, no force in the world will be able to stop your victim from accepting your challenge.
